subject: DPA + SCCs: order form routing, role mapping, and transfer impact addendum
messages:
From: Sara Ong <sara.ong@novamed.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA & SCCs: transfer impact and role routing — draft redlines

Hi Marcus / Laura / Irene,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. Attached is Novamed's initial set of redlines to the DPA and a short transfer inventory we put together to help you map the SCCs and scope of the transfer impact addendum. Key asks on our side:

- Clarify controller/processor role mapping in the Order Form (we see several callouts that say "processor" but the Order Form lists us as "controller" for patient records).
- Confirm which regions will be used for model training vs. inference; training data flows trigger additional SCC Annex II documentation for us.
- We propose an explicit Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA) exhibit rather than burying transfer routing in the main DPA so it's auditable.

I've highlighted items in red in the attached Word. Could you confirm if Redwood can accept the TIA as a separate exhibit or whether you prefer inlining? Also tagging Thomas Reed (CC: thomas.reed@novamed.com) on technical routing details.

Attachments: Novamed_DPA_redline_v1.docx, transfer-inventory-20250714.xlsx

Best,
Sara Ong
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Data
Novamed Health

---

On a practical note: if you want us to produce a table that maps each Order Form line item to the DPA role (controller/processor/subprocessor), we can send that by EOD tomorrow.

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Ong <sara.ong@novamed.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 12:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA & SCCs: transfer impact and role routing — draft redlines

Sara — thanks for sending this over and for the transfer inventory; very helpful. A few quick items from the Redwood side before we sync with legal/ops: 

1) High-level approach: we prefer a separate TIA exhibit when the transfer paths and export controls materially change responsibilities or trigger additional safeguards. That lets customers rely on a stable base DPA and accept a TIA per deployment.

2) Order Form role map: we can produce a per-line mapping but need the final Order Form SKU IDs (the ones that start with RF-). Can you confirm the set you expect to order in the next 60 days?

3) Technical routing: Irene, can you confirm whether our EU inference pool will be used for the Novamed pilot and if inference-only traffic will be blocked from reaching training clusters? If not, we need to add an explicit restriction and mention KMS separation in the DPA.

Proposed next steps:
- Laura: legal redline pass (target: Wed 7/16)
- Ben: ops/evidence summary (attachments list) and whether we need a subprocessor exception process documented for the TIA
- Marcus: schedule a 45-min sync with Novamed legal + technical ops (Thomas) — propose Wed 7/16 10:00am PT or Thu 7/17 11:00am PT.

I'll attach our consolidated whiteboard after we chat.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Model Contracts, Redwood Inference

---
(Attachment: orderform-draft-extract.pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: DPA & SCCs: transfer impact and role routing — internal ops ask

Marcus / Laura — quick ops note ahead of the call:

- The transfer inventory flags three external analytics subprocessors (EdgeStream, MedModelOps, TracerData). We need signed subprocessor addenda for TracerData before any export to the US.
- Evidence pack: I can assemble the SOC2 + encryption diagram + KMS key separation checklist. ETA EOD Tue (7/15).
- If we accept a separate TIA, ops will require a clear versioning scheme and an approval gate for any routing changes (suggest: major.minor, with minor changes requiring CS/Legal sign-off).

Also: Laura, there is a commercial ask from Novamed re: data residency guarantees in the Order Form. That will affect pricing for reserved capacity; if we concede hard residency guarantees we should surface a chargeback line.

Ben
Senior Manager, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Thomas Reed <thomas.reed@novamed.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Ong <sara.ong@novamed.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Updated redlines + proposed TIA exhibit

Marcus / team,

Thanks for the quick responses. We've taken Marcus' feedback and converted our inlined transfer clauses into a standalone Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA) exhibit — attached: Novamed_DPA_redline_v2.docx. The new exhibit has:

- A mapping table that ties each data type (PHI, Derived Model Outputs, Diagnostic Images) to the expected transfer paths and the relevant SCC Annexes.
- A proposed approval workflow for subprocessor additions (Novamed must be notified 21 days before new subprocessor onboarding for patient-data-related flows).
- A routing matrix that preserves EU inference for EU patient data but allows cross-border inference for deidentified analytics with explicit pseudonymization steps.

We also placed a DocuSign envelope on the MSA/Order Form so procurement can start while legal finishes the DPA redlines (link below). Let us know if the approval window and the 21-day notice are acceptable.

Attachments: Novamed_DPA_redline_v2.docx
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/fake-envelope/ENVELOPE-9982

Regards,
Thomas Reed
Director, Technical Compliance
Novamed Health

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Thomas Reed <thomas.reed@novamed.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Sara Ong <sara.ong@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA & SCCs: order form routing, role mapping, and transfer impact addendum — next steps

Thanks Thomas / Sara — appreciate the clear TIA exhibit. Confirming next steps from Redwood:

- Legal redline pass on Novamed_DPA_redline_v2.docx complete by Fri 7/18 EOD; I'll track comments in the Word.
- Ben to share evidence pack (SOC2 & KMS separation) to your security team by Fri 7/18 noon PT.
- Irene to confirm EU inference pool isolation and add the explicit KMS separation clause if required (Irene, ETA Thu 7/17 EOD).
- Marcus to join the procurement call on Thu 7/17 11:00am PT to discuss Order Form residency and pricing implications.

We'll keep the TIA as a separate exhibit but will include a short summary paragraph in the DPA body pointing to the exhibit (helps auditors). On the 21-day subprocessor notification: operationally that's OK but we will propose an exception path for emergency security patches with a 72-hour notice and post-facto confirmation — Ben will draft language.

I'll upload our redline by EOD Fri and share a link in HS-11672 for tracking. If Novamed wants to proceed with DocuSign for the MSA/Order Form while we finish DPA technical signoff, that's acceptable provided we add a procurement hold clause.

Thanks all — I'll circulate the meeting invite shortly.

Best,
Laura Bennett
VP, Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
